note: Ground-truth scripts for STT benchmark. Har script ko audio banakar (real voice recording preferred, ya TTS) audio/ folder me usi id se save karo: e.g. audio/t01.mp3. Keyterms = words jo sahi transcribe hona sabse critical hai.

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Can you explain how you would design a rate limiter for a distributed system using Redis, and what happens when a node fails?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: What is the difference between process and thread, and when would you use multiprocessing over multithreading in Python?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Tell me about a time you improved performance. By what percentage did latency drop, and how many requests per second were you handling?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: How does Kubernetes handle pod scheduling, and what is the role of etcd in the control plane?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Toh aap mujhe batao, aapne apne last project me database optimization kaise kiya tha, PostgreSQL me indexing use kiya tha kya?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Agar production me server down ho jaye raat ko, toh aapka approach kya hoga, pehle rollback karoge ya debugging start karoge?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Aap apne current company me kitne saal se ho, aur aap switch kyun karna chahte ho? Expected CTC kya hai aapka?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Aap mujhe apne baare me kuch bataiye, aapki sabse badi strength kya hai aur aap team ke saath kaise kaam karte hain?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Write a function that finds the longest substring without repeating characters. What will be the time complexity of your solution?

tests.speaker: interviewer
tests.text: Microservices architecture me aapne kabhi kaam kiya hai? Agar ek service fail ho jaye toh aap circuit breaker pattern kaise implement karoge?
